text:
rachel: Customer Y wants a 10-site POC delivered by encrypted USB 'seed-bundles' (not full images). Airgapped, strict monthly change window, and explicit attestation required.
peter: Seed-bundle = operator binary + model shard(s) (quantized) + delta patch set + signed manifest + SPDX SBOM. We can keep each drive <16GB with int8.
ivan: Key custody: we support customer-HSM signing (PKCS#11). Alternatively we can pre-sign artifacts and provide an escrow agreement, but legal review required.
rachel: Procurement asks for fixed per-site provisioning and optional on-site day rate. Any standard numbers?
peter: Typical: one-time provisioning fee per site + annual support band. On-site engineer is a day-rate add-on. We'll send a quoted example.
sec-bot: Ingestion policy: require checksum verification, AV scan on intake workstation, tag with site-id and policy-id. No outbound telemetry; telemetry disabled by default in offline mode.
ivan: Rollback: operator keeps previous two snapshots; rollback happens automatically if health checks fail within configured window (default 5m).
rachel: Can we do delta-only updates so they don't reimage?
peter: Yes. We produce signed delta bundles referencing prior bundle SHA256. Operator enforces chain-of-trust and will refuse mismatched base.
rachel: They also require the upgrade cadence locked to quarterly releases, hotfixes only with signed approval. Supported?
ivan: Supported. We support labels like "quarterly" and "hotfix" in manifest; hotfix application requires a signed ticket token.
rachel: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers (SBOM format, telemetry policy, crypto algorithms, HSM options). Ivan will draft a short runbook for USB import and attestation.
legal: Looping in legal for escrow and contract language around on-prem artifact signing.
rachel: Thanks team — aiming to have a pricing + runbook + questionnaire draft by EOD PT.
